d:
Prabhu shri ram ki janmabhumi ayodhya men bhavy mandir nirman aur unke svagat ke prati ullas evan utsah vyakt karti huee lie tilak ki navin prastuti "har ghar mandir har ghar utsav".
"Har Ghar Mandir Har Ghar Utsav" -A new presentation by Tilak expressing joy and enthusiasm for the grand temple construction at Lord Shri Ram's Janmbhoomi, Ayodhya.
